places: 1.3 km NE of Old Bight on Cat Island

fields.climate: tropical marine; moderated by warm waters of Gulf Stream
fields.terrain: long, flat coral formations with some low rounded hills
fields.hazards: hurricanes and other tropical storms cause extensive flood and wind damage
